source_snapshot.criteria: Tool PASS for uncorrectable errors, OS report within an undefined timeout and comparison with an unspecified AMD RAS specification/dmesg report.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; preserves operator injection but a generic WAFL grep cannot bind evidence to either physical link, source location or a fresh uncorrectable event.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Identifies interactive hardware risk but does not resolve the link placeholder or discriminate correctable from uncorrectable evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds topology approval, separate transcripts and recovery ownership, while leaving source label contradictions, threshold semantics and exact WAFL CPER fields open.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row 77 is the correctable WAFL variant. Row 79 narrows TXWAFL UCE to IOD/link0. This case must retain two source-defined locations and prove its distinct uncorrectable behavior.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A discovered link number is not sufficient: physical endpoint identity, injection location, severity, fresh event correlation and post-fault fabric health must be independently traceable.

original_test_intent: Inject an uncorrectable WAFL/TWIX fault at each source-defined location, verify the intended containment or reset and a fresh location-specific UCE report, then prove WAFL/fabric and host recovery with all temporary RAS settings restored.
original_method: Inventory the platform WAFL/TWIX topology; bind every listed link to socket, IOD/CCD endpoints and direction; obtain vendor semantics for errorlocation and errortype; preserve logs and raw BIOS/HDT state; inject one approved location once; correlate tool output with fresh MCA/APEI/WHEA/BERT and reset timeline; recover and health-check the link before separately approving the other location; restore and diff state.
manual_activity: The FAE maps WAFL links and endpoint ownership, resolves the Correctable/UCE wording, approves the exact link and errorlocation tuple, performs one location at a time under OOB observation, recovers the fabric and restores BIOS/HDT state.
required_inputs: Complete WAFL/TWIX link-to-socket/IOD/CCD/direction map and required coverage
Vendor proof for --twixwafl, errortype1 and errorlocation0/1, including whether source Socket 1/0 labels are correct
Decision on the two Correctable procedure labels versus the uncorrectable title, Criteria and errortype
MCA threshold FF5/FFE encoding, WAFL relevance and raw before/target/restore values
Expected UCE containment/reset policy and location-specific fresh MCA/APEI/WHEA/BERT/SEL fields
Supported OS, per-location timeout, fabric/link/traffic recovery thresholds, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated non-production SUT with independent BMC/serial console and no critical fabric traffic
Do not substitute a guessed or first-listed link; bind the exact enumerated identifier to physical topology
Inject one location once and require complete recovery plus evidence review before authorizing the second
Abort on ambiguous mapping, unexpected severity/reset, boot failure, persistent link error, data corruption, stale/missing record or inability to restore
No automatic retry, failover, reset or second-location continuation
agent_execution_scope: Validate immutable tool/spec identity, topology map, tuple semantics, baseline and evidence contract
Collect read-only link enumeration, raw settings, command transcript, OOB reset/boot, CPER/MCA/SEL and link-health evidence
Do not select links or locations, change BIOS/HDT, inject, drive recovery, continue to another location or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve source wording and approve topology/tuple/severity matrix
Approve threshold, containment/reset and durable UCE oracle
Supervise serialized per-location injection and recovery
Restore settings, verify fabric health and issue per-location verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A generic dmesg WAFL/corrected/uncorrected grep and SEL tail cannot prove which enumerated link or endpoint received errortype1, nor whether the event is fresh and uncorrectable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-approved link-to-endpoint map to run a single exact tuple under OOB capture, correlate a fresh location-specific UCE and deterministic containment/recovery, and authorize the second tuple only after full recovery.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: --listtwixwafllinks, quoted WAFL link placeholder, errorlocation0 then 1, errortype1, source Socket 1/0 wording, FF5-to-FFE threshold and 15/20-minute values are preserved as disputed inputs rather than silently corrected.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a topology-bound, serialized two-location WAFL UCE matrix with fresh source-specific durable evidence and full fabric recovery between injections.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable mapping, severity resolution, fresh evidence fields, deterministic containment, per-location deadlines, health checks and rollback proof.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tool PASS and a generic OS line do not prove correct link/location coverage or successful uncorrectable-fault recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An incorrect link or UCE tuple can disrupt the wrong fabric path, reset the host, isolate devices, corrupt traffic or prevent boot.

project_override_considerations: If the platform exposes a different number or topology of WAFL links, record explicit applicability per populated endpoint rather than forcing the two textual Socket labels. Preserve the two original source steps and escalate mapping differences instead of merging or deleting them.
expected_evidence: Platform/socket/IOD/CCD WAFL topology and complete raw link enumeration
Approved tool/spec identity, tuple semantics and raw BIOS/HDT/threshold baseline
Separate exact transcript and OOB timeline for each authorized location
Fresh location-specific UCE MCA/APEI/WHEA/BERT/SEL fields with expected containment or reset
Recovered link state, error counters, fabric traffic integrity and host/service health before any next injection
Raw restoration diff and engineer verdict for each location

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Both injection steps say Correctable while Items, Criteria and errortype1 say Uncorrectable. The WAFL link remains a placeholder, errorlocation0/1-to-Socket1/0 mapping is unsupported, and one link value may not cover both endpoints. Threshold relevance, exact UCE/reset behavior, durable signatures, OS method and timeout are undefined.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The WAFL UCE intent and original tuples are preserved. Engineering can resolve topology, wording, semantics and recovery criteria, so static review is complete while execution remains pending.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 78 Wistron-System RAS-00798-V002: correct or approve the two Correctable step labels in this WAFL Uncorrectable case; provide complete WAFL/TWIX link-to-socket/IOD/CCD mapping and exact per-location link values; prove --twixwafl errortype=1 and errorlocation 0/1 semantics; define FF5/FFE relevance, deterministic UCE containment/reset and fresh location-specific MCA/APEI/WHEA/BERT/SEL evidence; approve OS, timeouts, serialized recovery gates, aborts, OOB recovery and full restoration.

review_improvement: Turns an unresolved link placeholder and contradictory severity labels into a topology-bound two-location UCE contract with independent durable evidence and a mandatory recovery gate.
independent_technical_reasoning: The commands do not include a socket option, so the stated Socket 1/Socket 0 coverage depends entirely on undocumented linknumber and errorlocation semantics. Reusing one placeholder for both steps could target the same or wrong path. Because errortype1 may reset or isolate fabric, each location needs a fresh source ID and full link/traffic recovery before the other is attempted; tool PASS alone cannot establish either coverage or health.
